name: RemoteOK — all remote jobs
notes: Confirmed live and working via an actual pipeline run (2026-09-13). The ?tag=finance / ?tag=marketing query-param variant I originally guessed from web-search documentation returned HTTP 410 Gone in practice — that filtering apparently doesn't apply to this RSS endpoint (maybe JSON-API-only) — so this uses the unfiltered feed and relies on the heuristic classifier/scorer to sort relevant postings from the rest. Expect a lot of non-business-relevant tech jobs mixed in; that's expected, not a bug.
